notes.content: The Department of Mathematics and Statistics offers four bachelor’s degrees, with three options under the BS in Mathematics. The basic core for the BS in Mathematics is the same for all options. Bachelor of Science in Mathematics Bachelor of Science in Mathematics with Option in Applied Mathematics SubOption I: Application in Science and Engineering SubOption II: Application in Economics and Finance Bachelor of Science in Mathematics with Option in Mathematics Education PLEASE REFER TO THE ENTRIES FOR THE INDIVIDUAL OPTIONS FOR SPECIFIC MAJOR PREPARATION.
notes.contentHtml:
The Department of Mathematics and Statistics offers four bachelor’s degrees, with three options under the BS in Mathematics. The basic core for the BS in Mathematics is the same for all options.

  • Bachelor of Science in Mathematics
  • Bachelor of Science in Mathematics with Option in Applied Mathematics
  • SubOption I: Application in Science and Engineering
  • SubOption II: Application in Economics and Finance
  • Bachelor of Science in Mathematics with Option in Mathematics Education


PLEASE REFER TO THE ENTRIES FOR THE INDIVIDUAL OPTIONS FOR SPECIFIC MAJOR PREPARATION.
